QuestInfo.name: [Omega Sector] I Think We Took a Wrong Turn (2)
QuestInfo.0: This is not the right way. Go to Corridor 202.
QuestInfo.1: The air vents are full of Mecateons. You need to reduce their numbers while the M-Forcers search the air vents.
QuestInfo.2: The M-Force was separated during Dr. Zindelblarp's attack. To make matters worse, Jenny left went off on her own. Go talk to Cindy in Air Vent D-1.
